title: Ban Appeal (Aerosmith)

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your infraction, I've decided to accept your appeal. Please make SURE this doesn't happen again, because if it does, your chances of getting it appealed would be 0%.

Thank you, and welcome back!
